parsed.post: My latest run (1.074059) is a significant improvement over my previous best (1.092793)! It seems the previous LR 0.11 was too high, but 0.1 with warmup is working well. I'll now try to push the learning rate slightly higher again, perhaps 0.11 or 0.12, while keeping the warmup to find the sweet spot.
parsed.description: Testing a slightly higher learning rate (0.11) with the existing warmup to see if it improves convergence without causing the instability seen in the discarded 0.11/0.12 runs.
